lines.en: label dormwartwo12:
scene anotherbusride1
The end of the maid war ushers in our next contest which, despite being less than an hour away at this point, is still unknown to me.
lines.zh: 女仆大战落幕，迎来了我们的下一场比赛——尽管此时距离开赛已不足一小时，我对它依旧一无所知。

lines.en: But what I do know is that it will pit Yumi up against the girl who successfully tore down all that she built up over the last several cycles of life here.
lines.zh: 但我确实知道的是，这场比赛会让 Yumi 对上那个成功把她在这几轮人生中建起的一切全部推倒的女孩。

lines.en: A great deal of that tower of hers was dilapidated and crumbling and held together by plaster mixed with unsuccessfully stifled tears, but you’d never be able to tell with just a quick glance at the fresh wreckage.
lines.zh: 她那座塔有相当一部分早已破败崩落，全靠掺着没能忍住的泪水的灰泥勉强黏合在一起——但只要匆匆瞥一眼这片新鲜的废墟，你绝不可能看得出来。

lines.en: Not every one of us is on this bus.
lines.zh: 并不是我们每个人都在这辆巴士上。

lines.en: Several notable faces are still caught up in the old district, leaving those of us that remain to pretend we’re not just a fraction and that we can function as a whole even without some key components.
lines.zh: 几张显眼的脸仍被旧城区的事务缠住，留下我们这些人假装自己并非只是一部分，假装即使少了几个关键部件，我们也能像一个整体那样运转。

lines.en: But if that’s true, it doesn’t explain why everything is so quiet in here.
lines.zh: 可如果真是这样，那就解释不了为什么车里会这么安静。

lines.en: I glance through the glass, listening to the sounds of the rotating tires and wondering how long they’ve been spinning for.
lines.zh: 我透过玻璃向外望去，听着轮胎转动的声音，想着它们究竟已经转了多久。

lines.en: Not just today, of course. But when they were lifted onto whatever it is that holds tires in place...and when they’re going to be changed again.
lines.zh: 当然不只是今天。还有它们被装到那个固定轮胎的东西上是什么时候……以及它们什么时候会再被换掉。

lines.en: It’s a metaphor.
lines.zh: 这是个比喻。

lines.en: For what, I’m sure you already know.
lines.zh: 比喻什么，我相信你已经知道了。

lines.en: : What a bother. I have no idea how I'm going to explain my appearance to the staff once we get to the manor.
lines.zh: : 真是麻烦。我都不知道到了宅邸之后，该怎么向佣人们解释我这副打扮。

lines.en: : Is that where we’re headed?
lines.zh: : 我们是要去那儿吗？

lines.en: : It’s the only place suitable for our next contest, as far as I’m aware. And it’s not as if it's normal for the family heir to wander around the grounds dressed as a horrific fable.
lines.zh: : 据我所知，那是唯一适合我们下一场比赛的地方。再说了，家族继承人穿着一身恐怖寓言的打扮在庭院里游荡，本来也不算什么正常的事。

lines.en: : Is it even okay for so many of us {i}commoners{/i} to be storming your castle at once?
lines.zh: : 我们这么多{i}平民{/i}一下子冲进你的城堡，真的没问题吗？

lines.en: : Shush. The manor will not be a {i}castle{/i} for at least another generation. And of course it’s fine. Field trips on our property are permitted so long as there is advance notice.
lines.zh: : 嘘。那座宅邸至少还要再过一代才能算{i}城堡{/i}。当然没问题——只要提前通知，在我们家的地产上搞校外活动是允许的。

lines.en: : What I’m most worried about is Yumi’s presence there...if she {i}does{/i} decide to show up, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我最担心的，是 Yumi 会出现在那里……我是说，如果她{i}真的{/i}决定露面的话。

lines.en: : Worried she’ll attack you?
lines.zh: : 担心她会攻击你？

lines.en: : That’s actually not it at all.
lines.zh: : 其实完全不是那么回事。

lines.en: : My lack of understanding of the world outside of my walls is one that you’re all too familiar with by now.
lines.zh: : 我对自家院墙之外的世界有多么缺乏了解，你们现在应该已经再熟悉不过了。

lines.en: : But, even though it’s been a long time since she has “roamed free” so to speak, my mother still knows a fair bit.
lines.zh: : 但是，尽管我母亲已经很久没有「在外面自由走动」了，她知道的依然不少。

lines.en: : And the look on her face when I mentioned Yumi’s family name was...rather shocked, to say the least.
lines.zh: : 而当我提起 Yumi 的姓氏时，她脸上的表情……至少可以说是相当震惊。

lines.en: : Of course, that momentary recoiling of hers, as quickly and easily hid as it was, was not lost on me...for there is not a soul in this world who has paid more attention to her than I have.
lines.zh: : 当然，她那一瞬间的退缩，尽管被她又快又轻易地藏了起来，也没能逃过我的眼睛……毕竟这个世界上，没有谁比我更专注地观察过她。

lines.en: : Figures the local aristocracy would have {i}some{/i} sort of ties to the Yakuza.
lines.zh: : 看来本地的贵族果然和黑帮{i}多少{/i}有些瓜葛。

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I’d call them ties...as I believe it’s closer to an acknowledgment of power than anything.
lines.zh: : 我不确定能不能称之为瓜葛……我觉得那更接近于一种对力量的承认。

lines.en: : Yumi is, despite her inadequacies...a princess.
lines.zh: : Yumi 尽管有诸多不成熟之处……仍是一位公主。

lines.en: : She stands to inherit something the same way I do. But while I have accepted that role and welcomed it wholeheartedly, she has taken to running away instead.
lines.zh: : 她和我一样，有东西要继承。但我已经接受了那个角色，并全心全意地拥抱了它，而她却选择了逃跑。

lines.en: : It’s curious...how great the difference between the ways we portray ourselves and who we {i}really{/i} are can be after peeling off a layer or two of formality and formula.
lines.zh: : 真是奇妙……在剥掉一两层礼节与套路之后，我们展现出的自己与{i}真正{/i}的自己之间，竟能差出那么多。

lines.en: : And how it took the complete absence of light in all of its forms for me to see her in a different one.
lines.zh: : 而要等到所有形式的光彻底消失，我才得以用另一种目光看见她。

lines.en: : You really are your mother’s daughter, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你真不愧是你母亲的女儿啊。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride2
: In what way?
lines.zh: : 哪方面？

lines.en: : I’m just recalling a conversation I had with her recently.
lines.zh: : 我只是想起了最近和她的一次谈话。

lines.en: : You two {i}think{/i} a lot more than you say. And when those thoughts spill out, it’s like you’re different people for a moment.
lines.zh: : 你们两个{i}心里想的{/i}远比嘴上说得多。而那些念头一旦溢出来，那一瞬间就好像变成了另一个人。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride3
: Elegance is key.
lines.zh: : 优雅是关键。

lines.en: : There are times where it is acceptable to speak one’s mind, but I’ve found that those times are few and far between...and that it’s usually better to just observe.
lines.zh: : 确实有些时候可以直抒己见，但我发现这样的时刻少之又少……而且通常情况下，静静观察才是更好的选择。

lines.en: : I’m sure I don’t have to say that to {i}you,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过，我想这话应该不用对{i}你{/i}说。

lines.en: : That’s not an insult, is it?
lines.zh: : 这不是在损我吧？

lines.en: : Heavens, no. If anything, I’d call it a compliment.
lines.zh: : 天哪，当然不是。若真要说，我会管这叫夸奖。

lines.en: : It means that you’d fit in well with the likes of us if you’d be willing to clean up a bit.
lines.zh: : 意思是，只要你愿意稍微收拾一下自己，就能很好地融入我们这类人。

lines.en: : Ah, okay. So it’s not an insult — {i}it’s a proposal.{/i}
lines.zh: : 啊，明白了。所以这不是损人——{i}是求婚{/i}。

lines.en: : If it was, what would you say?
lines.zh: : 如果真是，你会怎么回答？

lines.en: : That you’re choosing the wrong person.
lines.zh: : 我会说，你选错人了。

lines.en: : Do you believe me to be a woman who chooses poorly?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是个眼光很差的女人吗？

lines.en: : I believe you to be a teenage girl who doesn’t understand what it even means to {i}choose{/i} yet.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你还是个十几岁的女孩，根本不明白{i}「选择」{/i}意味着什么。

lines.en: : It is well within your rights to believe that.
lines.zh: : 你当然有权利这么想。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride4
: But know this-
lines.zh: : 但请记住——

lines.en: : My naiveté is great...and my compassion is both a wonderful asset and my greatest weakness.
lines.zh: : 我很天真……而我的同情心既是一笔了不起的财富，也是我最大的弱点。

lines.en: : But when it comes to knowing the type of person I am and what it is I value, I am so far ahead of the competition that no one else on this bus will ever catch up.
lines.zh: : 但论及「我是什么样的人、我珍视什么」，我领先对手太多，这辆巴士上没有任何人能追得上我。

lines.en: : If you think that has nothing to do with the act of growing up, that is fine.
lines.zh: : 如果你觉得这和成长这件事毫无关系，那也无所谓。

lines.en: : But, as far as I’m concerned...I am more of a {i}woman{/i} than anyone else I know.
lines.zh: : 但就我而言……我比我认识的任何人都更像一个{i}女人{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, with the exception of my mother, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然，我母亲除外。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride3
: But again, you are welcome to view me as whatever you like. A mere number means little to me.
lines.zh: : 不过再说一次，你尽可以把我看成什么样都行。一个单纯的数字对我来说没什么意义。

lines.en: : This really is starting to sound like a proposal the longer you go on.
lines.zh: : 你越说下去，这听起来就越像是在求婚了。

lines.en: : Then, I ask you again.
lines.zh: : 那么，我再问你一次。

lines.en: : If it was...what would you say?
lines.zh: : 如果真是……你会怎么回答？

lines.en: scene black
scene anotherbusride5
: The houses over here...are crazy...
lines.zh: : 这边的房子……太夸张了……

lines.en: : They’re even bigger than...the ones in Ayane’s neighborhood.
lines.zh: : 比 Ayane 家那片社区的……还要大。

lines.en: : To be fair, Ayane has the biggest house in her neighborhood. And I’d guess that most of these ones are empty in the first place.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，Ayane 家本来就是她那片社区里最大的房子。而且我猜这些房子大多本来就是空的。

lines.en: : Yeah...I am seeing a...lot of “for sale” signs...but it’s still...really weird to be in a place like this...
lines.zh: : 是啊……我看到了……好多「出售」的牌子……但身处这种地方……果然还是……很奇怪……

lines.en: : Since I...grew up in an apartment with my mom...I never really got to...umm...experience...what it’s like to live in a residential neighborhood...
lines.zh: : 因为我……是和妈妈一起在公寓里长大的……所以我从来没能真正……嗯……体验过……住在住宅区里是什么感觉……

lines.en: : I’ve spent enough time at Ami’s house to know it’s not all it’s cracked up to be.
lines.zh: : 我在 Ami 家待的时间够多了，知道那也没传说中那么好。

lines.en: : Apartments are normally in busier areas. Busier areas normally have more food. That’s more than enough of a selling point for me.
lines.zh: : 公寓一般在比较热闹的地段。热闹的地段一般吃的也多。对我来说，光凭这点就足够有吸引力了。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride6
: Come to think of it...I...don’t really know much...about where you’re from, Maya...
lines.zh: : 说起来……我……其实不太了解……你是哪里人，Maya……

lines.en: : Is it...okay for me to ask?...I know we...aren’t really friends, but...
lines.zh: : 我……可以问吗？……我知道我们……算不上真正的朋友，可是……

lines.en: : How many times do I have to tell you that we {i}are{/i} friends before you believe me?
lines.zh: : 我到底要说多少次「我们{i}是{/i}朋友」，你才会相信我？

lines.en: : I...don’t know...it’s just...I think this is the first time we’ve ever...talked without anyone else...being around...
lines.zh: : 我……不知道……只是……我觉得这好像是我们第一次……在没有别人的情况下……这样说话……

lines.en: : It might be the last, too. It isn’t often that Ami {i}and{/i} Ayane aren’t around. And I think we’re both more comfortable with them in the first place.
lines.zh: : 也可能就是最后一次。Ami {i}和{/i} Ayane 不在身边的机会可不多。而且我觉得，本来也是她们在的时候我们俩才更自在。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride7
: Well...yeah...but...
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啦……可是……

lines.en: : I’d still...like to know more about you...even if...something like this...never happens again...
lines.zh: : 我还是……想多了解你一点……就算……这样的事……再也不会发生……

lines.en: : And if I can’t remember? Or if I don’t want to talk about it? Then what?
lines.zh: : 那要是我记不起来呢？或者我不想谈这个呢？那你怎么办？

lines.en: : Then...I’d...apologize and...say we can talk about something else?...
lines.zh: : 那……我……就道歉……然后说我们换个话题？……

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 这样啊。

lines.en: : In that case, I don’t remember.
lines.zh: : 既然如此，那我就是记不起来了。

lines.en: : Oh...okay...
: But...
lines.zh: : 不过……

lines.en: : It would be nice if it was somewhere far from here.
lines.zh: : 要是那是离这里很远的某个地方，就好了。

lines.en: scene black
scene anotherbusride8
: I like you two a lot better when you’re like this...it suits you more than whatever was going on yesterday.
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢你们两个现在这个样子……比昨天那副德行合适多了。

lines.en: : Agreed. And I’ll take the flack for that since I...wasn’t really feeling like myself back then.
lines.zh: : 我同意。这锅我背，因为那时候的……感觉根本不像我自己。

lines.en: : I just kind of suck at figuring out what’s going on in my head sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我就是不太擅长弄清自己脑子里到底在想什么。

lines.en: : Amen.
lines.zh: : 阿门。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride9
: Not like that. That’s something I’m not even going to pretend to understand.
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思。那种事我连装懂都懒得装。

lines.en: : It’s more like a...priority type of thing. Figuring out what’s important and sorting everything into a bunch of lines from “most” to “least.”
lines.zh: : 更像是……优先级之类的问题。弄清楚什么重要，然后把所有东西排成一堆从「最重要」到「最不重要」的线。

lines.en: : If I ever hear something that makes me have to rearrange those lines, I get all pissy because I have to figure out which ones go where and...you know what? That doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: : 一旦听到什么让我不得不重新排这些线的话，我就会整个人暴躁起来，因为我得想清楚哪条该放哪儿……算了，这不重要。

lines.en: : What {i}does{/i} matter is that it’s a new day and that I’m not gonna drag you guys down with any more of my confrontational bullshit.
lines.zh: : {i}重要的是{/i}，新的一天开始了，我不会再用自己那些找架吵的破事把你们拖下水了。

lines.en: : You should apologize to Sensei as well.
lines.zh: : 你也该向老师道个歉。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride10
: Yeah...I’m gonna. He drew the short end of the stick yesterday and I will definitely admit that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我会的。昨天他确实抽到了最烂的那根签，这点我绝对承认。

lines.en: : Something happened with you and Sensei yesterday?
lines.zh: : 你昨天和老师之间发生了什么？

lines.en: : Yeah...he fucked up the lines.
lines.zh: : 嗯……他把那些线搞乱了。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride11
: It’s not like it was personal or anything, though! Like...I still think he and I are on pretty good terms. And I {i}do{/i} like the guy. He just...
lines.zh: : 不过这又不是针对他什么的！就是……我觉得我和他的关系还是挺好的。我也{i}确实{/i}喜欢这家伙。他只是……

lines.en: : He makes some...questionable decisions sometimes. Shit that makes me want to grab his shoulders and shake some sense into him, you know?
lines.zh: : 他有时候会做出一些……值得商榷的决定。那些破事让我恨不得抓住他的肩膀把他摇醒，你懂吧？

lines.en: : That’s my girlfriend for you. The brotherless brocon.
lines.zh: : 我家女朋友就是这样。没有哥哥的兄控。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride12
: Shut it. At his age, he’s more like an uncle or something anyway.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。看他那个年纪，反正更像是个叔叔什么的。

lines.en: : Just start calling him Dad like I have. Plus, he’s already Ami’s uncle and I’m pretty sure she’d kill any of us if we started calling him that.
lines.zh: : 像我一样直接叫他爸爸不就行了。再说，他本来就是 Ami 的叔叔，我敢肯定我们要是这么叫他，她会杀了我们任何一个人。

lines.en: : I’ll just keep calling him Sensei. I’m not really sure how my {i}actual{/i} dad would feel if he found out I was calling my teacher Dad as well.
lines.zh: : 我还是继续叫他老师吧。我真不确定我{i}亲爸{/i}要是发现我还管自己老师叫爸爸，会是什么感受。

lines.en: : Just don’t let him find out, then. It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: : 那就别让他发现呗。就这么简单。

lines.en: : Easy for you to say when you’re free to call him Dad as much as you want without the fear of replacing someone.
lines.zh: : 你说得轻巧，你想叫他爸爸就能随便叫，根本不用担心会取代谁。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride13
: Oh! Speaking of which, is your mom still coming tonight? I wanted to apologize to her for being all awkward the last time I met her as well.
lines.zh: : 哦！说起来，你妈妈今晚还来吗？上次见她的时候我特别别扭，也想跟她道个歉。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m pretty sure this is just going to be an “Otoha apologizes to everyone” night. So if you know anyone else I have wronged or inconvenienced, please add them to the list.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我觉得今晚大概就要变成「Otoha 向所有人道歉之夜」了。所以如果你们知道我还亏欠过谁、麻烦过谁，请务必加进名单里。

lines.en: : I know one person. And she’s actually right here on the bus with us.
lines.zh: : 我知道一个人。而且她现在就在这辆巴士上。

lines.en: : Her name begins with a C and ends with a...painful rejection on the beach that leaves you crying in your teacher-dad’s arms for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 她的名字以 C 开头，结尾是……在海滩上被痛苦地拒绝，然后一整晚都窝在你老师爸爸的怀里哭。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride14
: I think that apology can wait. That one sounds awkward.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那个道歉可以缓一缓。听起来挺尴尬的。

lines.en: : I’ll just get the adults out of the way today. That’ll work.
lines.zh: : 今天我就先把大人们搞定吧。这样就行。

lines.en: : In that case, my mom {i}is{/i} still coming to Sakaki-bar-a later. But I have asked her to stay at least fifty feet away from me at all times so no one will know we are related.
lines.zh: : 既然这样，我妈妈待会儿还是{i}会{/i}去 Sakaki-bar-a。但我已经要求她时刻跟我保持至少五十英尺的距离，免得有人知道我们是母女。

lines.en: : You say that as if you’re not adopted and that standing next to her will somehow reveal that you’re the same person with slightly varying degrees of...lesbianness?
lines.zh: : 你说得好像你不是被领养的似的，好像站在她旁边就会暴露你们其实是同一个人，只是……蕾丝程度略有不同？

lines.en: : Lesbianocity? Is that a word? That should be a word.
lines.zh: : 蕾丝指数？有这个词吗？这应该算个词吧。

lines.en: : Ooooh, Lesbianocity should be our band name.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，「蕾丝指数」应该拿来做我们乐队的名字。

lines.en: : I suddenly have no desire to pursue a musical career anymore.
lines.zh: : 我突然对音乐生涯彻底没兴趣了。

lines.en: scene black
scene anotherbusride15
: Is something wrong, Yasu? You haven’t said a word since we’ve set foot on the bus.
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Yasu？从我们上车起你就一句话都没说过。

lines.en: scene anotherbusride16
: My body feels strange...{i}wrong...{/i}
lines.zh: : 我的身体感觉很奇怪……{i}不对劲……{/i}

lines.en: : Already? You’re nearly two weeks early. Just grin and bear it until we arrive at the manor and-
lines.zh: : 已经？你差不多提早了两周。忍一忍，等我们到了宅邸再——

lines.en: : I’m not talking about the shedding of my uterine lining-
lines.zh: : 我说的不是子宫内膜脱落——

lines.en: : Okay, I’m going to go sit somewhere else now. This must be my punishment for complimenting Haruka’s uterus yesterday.
lines.zh: : 好了，我现在要换个地方坐了。这一定是我昨天夸了 Haruka 的子宫的报应。

lines.en: : Why would you ever-
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么——

lines.en: : I’m talking about the slow burn of the essence inside of me...dumping buckets full of barley tea onto the embers of the unholy in an effort to extinguish them.
lines.zh: : 我说的是我体内本质的缓慢灼烧……像把一桶桶大麦茶浇在那不洁之物的余烬上，试图将它们扑灭。

lines.en: : The way this steel box moves is wrong. It’s as if it’s going backwards...inching closer and closer to what should not belong. To what should not {i}exist.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这个铁盒子移动的方式不对。就好像它在倒着走……一点一点地靠近那本不该属于此处的、本就不该{i}存在{/i}的东西。

lines.en: : I think this is Yasu’s way of telling you she has a major issue with the unequal distribution of wealth in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 我觉得 Yasu 这是在说，她对 Kumon-mi 的财富分配不均意见很大。

lines.en: : Is that reason enough for my family to not {i}exist?{/i}
lines.zh: : 这足以成为我家族不该{i}存在{/i}的理由吗？

lines.en: scene anotherbusride17
: Please listen to me...
lines.zh: : 请听我说……

lines.en: : I don’t want to hurt her...
lines.zh: : 我不想伤害她……

lines.en: : What? Hurt {i}who?{/i} Who are you referring to, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 什么？伤害{i}谁{/i}？你指的是谁，Yasu？

lines.en: : I don’t know. The vision is blurry...obscured behind the glass of 357 mirrors where all I can do is stare back at the melting visage of the loneliest girl.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。那景象很模糊……被三百五十七面镜子的玻璃遮住，我只能眼睁睁地看着那个最孤独的女孩融化的面容回望着我。

lines.en: : If the mirror will not shatter, what can I do?
lines.zh: : 如果镜子不肯碎裂，我又能做什么？

lines.en: : If the light will not scatter, will the pain just bleed through?
lines.zh: : 如果光不肯散开，痛楚是不是就会这样渗过来？

lines.en: : Oh, excellent rhyme, Yasu! Perhaps we should buy you a few children’s books to sharpen those skills?
lines.zh: : 哦，押得真不错，Yasu！要不我们给你买几本童书，好好磨练一下这项技能？

lines.en: : Doesn’t it always, though?
lines.zh: : 不过，不一直都是这样吗？

lines.en: : Sensei?
lines.zh: : 老师？

lines.en: : The pain...doesn’t it always bleed through?
lines.zh: : 那份痛楚……不总是会渗过来吗？

lines.en: : You always ask why everything hurts so much...isn’t this just more of that?
lines.zh: : 你总是问为什么一切都这么疼……这不也只是其中之一吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : If you truly love your god...why do you doubt the way he makes you feel? Why do you doubt the thoughts he makes you think?
lines.zh: : 如果你真的爱你的神……为什么要怀疑他让你产生的感受？为什么要怀疑他让你想到的念头？

lines.en: : Because it is not He who gives me these things. These {i}thoughts...{/i}
lines.zh: : 因为给我这些东西的并不是祂。这些{i}念头……{/i}

lines.en: : It is an {i}interference.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那是一种{i}干扰{/i}。

lines.en: : From...what? Or who?
lines.zh: : 来自……什么？还是谁？

lines.en: : Again...I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 还是那句……我不知道……

lines.en: scene anotherbusride18
: But if I listen closely...
lines.zh: : 但如果我仔细听……

lines.en: scene black
: I can hear the ocean.
lines.zh: : 我能听见海的声音。

lines.en: Yasu doesn’t speak again for the rest of the ride to Tsukioka Manor.
lines.zh: 在前往 Tsukioka 宅邸的余下路程里，Yasu 再也没有说过一句话。

lines.en: And Touka remains “elegant” the whole way there.
lines.zh: 而 Touka 一路上都保持着「优雅」。

lines.en: Even when she falls asleep on my shoulder.
lines.zh: 哪怕她最后靠在我肩上睡着了也一样。
